title: Carrollian Dictionary for Massive Particles at Null Infinity
summary: Massive particles reach timelike rather than null infinity, leaving their Carrollian boundary description unresolved. We construct a Carrollian dictionary for massive one-particle states on $\mathscr I^\pm$ without requiring their worldlines to reach null infinity. The dictionary encodes the bulk momentum through its projections onto the null frame associated with each celestial point. The Poincaré intertwining equations require the complete Carrollian representation to describe massive states.
